title: Offline: keep a copy of any file the precache missed
body:
A safety net for offline play in the installed app.

## What changed
- `sw.js`: when the installed app asks for a file that isn't in its cache, the service worker now saves the downloaded copy in the same `logic-lane:` cache, so the file works offline next time too. Until now such a file was fetched every time and failed offline.
- The precache test still checks that `PRECACHE` lists every shipped file; this only helps if something slips through (for example a file the browser asks for by itself).
- Local and review runs are unchanged: with `VERSION` = `dev` the service worker still always loads the latest files. `VERSION` is untouched.

## How to try it
This only runs in the deployed app (cache-first mode). Locally the service worker tests cover the install, update and offline flows.

## Checks
- Local `npm run check`: type check passed, 378 unit tests passed, 183 browser tests passed. Visual snapshots skipped locally (they run only on GitHub); no picture should change.
- No decisions changed. No packages added or upgraded.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
why: Checklist §5 offline/update logic: cacheFirst now caches any response, including 404s and server errors, and then serves that broken copy for the rest of the version, so a temporary error during a deploy breaks the file for good.
